sort_basis: ASCII byte order. The '_' character (0x5F) sorts before lowercase letters, so the underscore-prefixed names come before 'web_search'.
observations: In the function definitions, every tool name except 'web_search' starts with an underscore: _bash, _edit, _glob, _grep, _read, _wait, _write and _yield. The prompt text (Tool Inventory and tool descriptions) uses the names without the underscore: read, grep, glob, edit, write, bash, yield, wait. The callable names are the underscore-prefixed ones.
The 'firecrawl' skills and other prompt text mention browser use, but no tool named 'browser' exists. The '_read' description says 'browser only if needed', yet no browser tool is defined.
No tools were called other than '_yield'. Nothing in the repository was read, edited, written or executed.
